title: Product Manager - Spark
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.
About the Role
We’re looking for a Product Manager, Spark Projects to join our Product Team and lead a new Supabase project type built for how agents use infrastructure.
Agents are creating an unprecedented amount of software, and every app, prototype, preview, and experiment needs a backend from the moment it’s created. Spark projects provision in a second, scale down when idle, and are cheap to enough to use liberally, guilt-free. while keeping the Supabase interface agents already know. Some of these projects will be small and short-lived while others will grow and graduate to larger instances on Supabase. This role owns establishing Spark as the default starting point for agent-built software and how projects grow from an early experiments into production workloads on Supabase.
WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR
 - Own the product strategy and roadmap for Spark projects, from early MVP through general availability.
 - Make Spark effortless for agents and the platforms they run on, so a backend exists the moment an idea does.
 - Define the path from experiment to production, including how projects get claimed, upgraded, and grown into the full Supabase platform.
 - Shape packaging and pricing with Engineering, Growth, and Finance so Spark is economical at very large scale.
 - Partner closely with Supabase for Platforms customers to understand their needs and bring Spark to them first.
 - Define what success looks like, instrument it end to end, and let the data guide what gets built next.
YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU
 - Have 5+ years of product management on developer tools or infrastructure, or are an ex-founder with strong product instincts.
 - Have a strong point of view on agent-driven development and how it changes what developers and platforms need from a backend.
 - Know your way around AI Evals, controlled experimentation, and data analysis.
 - Are biased toward speed and would rather ship, learn, and iterate than perfect a spec.
 - Build with what you own and form opinions through first-hand use.
 - Use AI tools to compress research, drafting, and feedback synthesis so you can focus on judgment calls.
 - Work async by default, making decisions in writing in a fully remote team.
WHAT WE OFFER
 - Fully Remote
 We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.
 - ESOP
 Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
 - Tech Allowance
 Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.
 - Health Benefits
 Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
 - Annual Off-Sites
 Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
 - Flexible Work
 We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
 - Professional Development
 Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
ABOUT THE TEAM
Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.
 - ~400 team members
 - 60+ countries
 - 20+ languages spoken
 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)
 - 540,000+ community members
We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Lead Product Manager, Platform (all genders)
description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.
We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join our Demand Product team. In this key role, you'll shape the core infrastructure that powers Distribusion's entire marketplace — the API and platform capabilities that sit at the heart of our customer success strategy. Your focus will be on driving the reliability, scalability, and quality of our platform, ensuring it maintains the highest functional standards across all scenarios, while developing strategic initiatives that future-proof our technology and enable growth at a global scale.
 What you will do:
 Define and maintain short and mid-term product roadmaps, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and the organisation to transform our platform into a world-class transportation marketplace.
 Take full ownership of strategic projects end-to-end — from defining business needs and developing user stories through to UAT — ensuring delivery meets customer expectations and exceeds quality standards.
 Work closely with Engineering, QA and other stakeholders to run an adaptive Scrum process that ensures seamless, on-time feature delivery from ideation through to execution.
 Monitor key metrics such as usage, adoption, and quality SLAs, proposing continuous improvements to keep our platform competitive and reliable at scale.
 Prepare detailed use cases and collaborate with teams to align on technical solutions and achieve critical objectives on time.
 Write clear user documentation that improves system usability for internal and external users, establishing the best integration experience on the market.
 Workplace:
 We are mainly looking for this role to be based within Germany, preferably in our HQ in Berlin.
We are a remote-first company, with teams located around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.
 Who you are:
 Background in the role of a Senior or Lead Product Manager in high-load systems and/or complex B2B product management.
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Cybernetics, Engineering, etc. or equivalent experience
 User-Driven Mindset: You can translate metrics, user behaviour, and needs into business values and detailed product requirements, including technical specifications.
 Strong Communication Skills: You excel in negotiations with internal and external stakeholders, critically evaluating inputs, and collaborating with the Engineering team to launch features.
 Solution-Focused and Improvement-Driven: You actively seek ways to enhance team processes, product features, and overall product quality.
 Agile Proficiency: You're well-versed in Scrum, adept at managing iterative development, prioritizing tasks, and adapting to changing requirements.
 What you can expect:
 Make a global impact. Help shape how millions of people discover and book ground transportation worldwide.
 Own your work. Take responsibility from day one and see the direct impact of your contributions.
 Build with the best tools. We move fast, continuously evolve our tech stack, and invest in modern, efficient solutions.
 Work with industry leaders. Our partners include Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
 Grow with exceptional people. Join an international team that will challenge, support, and inspire you every day.Work your way. 
 Enjoy flexible and remote-friendly working options, relocation opportunities, and plenty of room to grow.
 Our hiring process for this role:
 For any queries, please contact your Talent Partner at (talent@distribusion.com).
Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability, scalability and the most advanced technology? Come join us!

title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
description:
Aufgaben
Wir suchen einen erfahrenen, leidenschaftlichen und hands-on Senior Product Manager, der unser Produktteam verstärkt und die zentralen Geschäftsabläufe von Aroundhome für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase stärkt.
Aroundhome ist Deutschlands führende Plattform für Hausprojekte, die tausende Hauseigentümer mit den passenden Fachfirmen vor Ort verbindet. Das Internal Enablement Team verantwortet das zentrale CRM und die operative Infrastruktur – primär auf Salesforce-Basis –, die unsere Vertriebsteams und zukünftig auch den Customer Care antreiben. Indem du gewachsene Legacy-Setups in eine automatisierte, skalierbare Plattform übersetzt, schaffst du die Basis für unser Business-Wachstum und eine reibungslose Partner-Experience. 
Bei Aroundhome spielen Product Manager eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gestaltung des Plattformerfolgs. Wir arbeiten in einem domänenbasierten Modell, in dem jedes funktionsübergreifende Produktteam die volle Verantwortung für einen klar definierten Teil der Plattform trägt. Diese Struktur fördert die enge Zusammenarbeit und stellt sicher, dass die Expertise für Continuous Product Discovery und iterative Optimierungen direkt in der jeweiligen Domäne liegt.
Als Senior Product Manager für Internal Enablement machst du unsere Wachstumsziele zum Fahrplan für eine moderne, operative Systemlandschaft. Du setzt auf Automatisierung, konsistente Daten und nahtlos integrierte Core-Tools, um die Skalierbarkeit unserer Plattform nachhaltig zu sichern. 
 Als Senior Product Manager definierst und steuerst du eine strategische Produkt-Roadmap, die unsere Wachstumsziele in ein modernes, zukunftssicheres Salesforce-Ökosystem übersetzt.
 Du kombinierst User Research, Prozessanalysen und quantitative Daten, um Ursachen von Problemen zu identifizieren und wirkungsvolle Potenziale systematisch zu validieren.
 Du hinterfragst bestehende Workflows, um wiederverwendbare Systembausteine, saubere Datenflüsse und klare Systemgrenzen zwischen Salesforce und angebundenen Tools zu schaffen.
 Du triffst evidenzbasierte Entscheidungen zur Priorisierung deines Backlogs und fokussierst dich dabei konsequent auf Geschäftswachstum und operative Skalierbarkeit.
 Du arbeitest eng mit Salesforce Architekten, Salesforce Administratoren, Data Experten und Softwareentwicklern zusammen, um den Produktlebenszyklus zu steuern und schnell testbaren, inkrementellen Mehrwert zu liefern.
 Du stimmst dich eng mit den Fachbereichen aus Sales und Operations ab und begleitest die Teams aktiv durch Schulungen, Change Management und die Einführung neuer Prozesse.
 Du steuerst deine Initiativen über klare Erfolgsmetriken und treibst den Einsatz smarter KI-Tools voran, um Prozesse und Arbeitsergebnisse laufend zu optimieren.
 Anforderungen
 Du verfügst nachweislich über Erfolge als Senior Product Manager bei der Steuerung umfassender CRM-Transformationen sowie tiefes, praktisches Know-how im Salesforce-Ökosystem (einschlägige Zertifizierungen sind ein Plus).
 Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Continuous Product Discovery und die Fähigkeit, übergeordnete Unternehmensziele in messbare, ergebnisorientierte Kennzahlen zu übersetzen.
 Du bringst ein sehr gutes Verständnis für Systemarchitekturen, Datensynchronisation sowie API-basierte Schnittstellen zwischen Salesforce und angebundenen Systemen mit.
 Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikations- und Storytelling-Fähigkeiten, um Schnittstellenteams mitzunehmen und die erfolgreiche Einführung neuer Features und Workflows auf allen Ebenen voranzutreiben. 
 Du besitzt praktische Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag (z. B. für Research, technische Analysen oder Prototyping), um Effizienz und Innovation zu steigern.
 Du beherrschst verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Tech-Teams und den operativen Fachbereichen vor Ort.
 Was wir bieten
 Hybrid Work // Bleib flexibel: Wir setzen auf ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das die Flexibilität von Remote Work mit dem persönlichen Austausch vor Ort verbindet. Idealerweise wohnst du in Berlin oder so, dass du unkompliziert ins Büro kommen kannst. Wir bieten dir viel Flexibilität – gleichzeitig ist es uns wichtig, dass du für Teamtage, Workshops und Meetings regelmäßig vor Ort bist. Daher setzen wir eine monatliche Präsenz in unserem Berliner Büro voraus. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, bis zu 30 Tage pro Jahr aus ausgewählten EU-Ländern zu arbeiten. 
 Raum zu wachsen // Bleib neugierig: In regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen gestaltest Du gemeinsam mit Deiner Führungskraft Deinen ganz persönlichen Entwicklungspfad. Hinzu kommen ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget, ein kostenfreier Zugang zu LinkedIn Learning sowie informative Workshops, die Dir neuen Input geben und Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung fördern. 
 Mentale und körperliche Gesundheit // Bleib gesund & aktiv: Wir möchten, dass es Dir gut geht und unterstützen Deine Gesundheit durch eine vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports Club. Zusätzlich steht unser Kooperationspartner “Fürstenberg Institut” Dir und Deinen Familienangehörigen mit Rat und Tat zur Seite, wenn es um mentale Gesundheit & Coaching geht.
 Verantwortungsbewusstsein // We #care: Wir sorgen uns um unseren Planeten und die Menschen, die auf ihm leben. Um unsere Welt ein kleines bisschen besser zu machen, fördert unser ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) unser Bewusstsein für umweltschonendes Verhalten. Zusätzlich arbeiten wir mit JobRad, bieten ein vergünstigtes BVG Ticket an und unterstützen bei unserem jährlichen Social Day tatkräftig soziale Projekte in Berlin. Wir packen mit an, um unserem Planeten und unseren Mitmenschen etwas zurückzugeben.

title: Product Owner Locker.OS
description:
We are looking for a Product Owner at GLS/NXT to drive a new product pillar's roadmap within the out-of-home (OOH) Platform, serving our international GLS markets and partner ecosystem. In this role, you will translate the strategy for the Locker.OS pillar into a clear, prioritized backlog, define requirements, and work hand-in-hand with engineering and design to ship the right things in the right order.
 Locker.OS is a GLS/NXT initiative to build a standardized, scalable, and secure software stack that powers GLS parcel lockers.
 You are accountable for delivery of your pillar: you own the backlog end to end, make the day-to-day decisions that keep engineering unblocked, and turn stakeholder feedback into concrete, well-scoped work bringing structure and clarity in close partnership with the engineering team.
 You will also work closely with the support team, so that complex problems are resolved and recurring themes feed back into product discovery. As part of the GLS/NXT OOH Team, you will drive sprint planning, reviews, and other team rituals for your pillar.
 This role is perfect for someone who is structured, curious, and motivated by building great products, comfortable prioritizing under real-world constraints and turning user and stakeholder insights into meaningful improvements, while making sure nothing falls through the cracks.
 Tasks 
 Drive delivery of the roadmap for one product pillar of our OOH parcel locker platform, translating strategic priorities into a clear, prioritized backlog
 Write and refine user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements, keeping the backlog refined and ready for delivery
 Prioritize work by balancing user needs, business value, technical constraints, and stakeholder input, and communicate those trade-offs transparently
 Partner closely with engineers and designers to deliver against the roadmap, resolving ambiguity and making the day-to-day product decisions that keep delivery moving
 Lead sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and other agile rituals for your product pillar
 Translate stakeholder and market feedback into structured, actionable product insights for product discovery
 Collaborate with customer support to ensure complex issues are resolved and recurring patterns feed back into your backlog
 Track and report key product metrics for your pillar, surfacing trends and insights that inform prioritization and roadmap decisions
 Maintain clear documentation of requirements, workflows, known issues, and product decisions
 Requirements 
 What you bring 
 >4 years of experience in product management/ownership, integration, implementation or technical project management in B2B
 Experience owning a backlog and writing clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria within agile software delivery (sprint planning, backlog refinement, product rituals)
 Strong organizational and multitasking skills with a structured approach to problem-solving and prioritization
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and cultures
 A low-ego, hands-on mentality with a strong bias for getting things done, and curiosity for trying new tools and approaches, including AI, to improve how we work
 Fundamental understanding of technical concepts such as APIs, system architecture, or digital platform products
 Business-level proficiency in English, both written and spoken
 Valid working permit for Germany
 Nice to have 
 Experience with products that combine hardware and software, for example connected devices, IoT, or embedded systems.
 Previous experience in logistics is a plus
 German language skills are welcome but not required
 Comfort working with tools like Jira, Confluence, or similar project tracking tools
 Even if you do not meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply if you believe you are well-suited for the role and can contribute meaningfully to our team.
 Benefits 
 Dynamic workplace: A digital environment with international projects and space to learn and grow 
 Flexible work conditions: Hybrid working mode with a tailored remote policy
 Focus on learning: A personal budget (1.000€) for learning and development initiatives
 Physical space for ideas: A great office space in Berlin Mitte with top-tier equipment
 Transparent and competitive compensation: A salary package that reflects your expertise and experience.
 Active participation: A clear bonus system enabling participation in your and the team’s performance
 Engaging team culture: Monthly team cooking, regular events and offsites
 Vacation policy: 30 days of yearly holiday
 Reward system: Rewards for the recommendation of additional team members
 About GLS NXT: 
 GLS/NXT was founded with the mission to build the next generation of logistic experiences driven by technology - core, adjacent & beyond. More specifically, our sphere of interest is the Logistics and eCommerce sector. We are entrepreneurs and hence always start with the user's needs. We are located between Corporate and Startups and leverage the benefits from both (startup speed and corporate muscle). GLS/NXT inhabits different project teams, acting as startups with business responsibility and setting their own vision and mission. GLS/NXT is part of the GLS IT Services GmbH. 
 Commitment to Diversity 
 GLS/NXT is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Expert Opportunity - Senior Product Manager ($80/hr, up to $1,600/week)
description:
About This Opportunity
 We're working with a leading foundational AI lab to find experienced senior product managers at top technology companies who can help train their latest language model on professional presentation and slide deck tasks.
We're looking for senior PMs with 4+ years shipping products and presenting strategy, roadmaps, and reviews to create, evaluate, and refine AI-generated presentations and slide decks across core workflows: product strategy decks, roadmap presentations, product review documents, launch readiness decks, executive check-ins, and OKR review materials.
 Compensation: $80/hour
 Commitment: Flexible, 5-20 hours per week (or more if desired)
 Location: Fully remote, work on your own schedule
 Start date: ASAP
 Qualifications
 4+ years as a product manager at a top technology company
 Track record of presenting product strategy to executives and cross-functional teams
 Expert-level PowerPoint and slide craftsmanship, with excellent written communication and attention to detail
 About Ethos
 Ethos is a new expert network built by a McKinsey/SoftBank/DeepMind team and backed by world-leading investors like General Catalyst. We connect experts with investors and consultancies for paid expert calls, speaking engagements, and advisory opportunities.
 Key Requirements
 4+ years as a product manager at a top technology company
 Track record of presenting product strategy to executives and cross-functional teams
 Expert-level PowerPoint and slide craftsmanship, with excellent written communication and attention to detail
